Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1575.jpg'}
{1: 'Getting in took longer than expected.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'By now, the blue glow inside is faint.'}
{1: 'Even so, that faint blue light feels unreal. The water no longer looks like ordinary seawater. It shines like a gem.'}
{1: 'The reflections rippling across the rock walls almost look more like the real ocean.'}
{1: "The boat is floating on the surface, yet it feels as if you're deep under the sea.", 7: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront186.png', 4: '4', 7: '0|-80|0'}
{1: '1', 2: 'By/idle_SSJC', 3: 'By/idle_SSJC_blink', 5: 'Fa/idle_SSJC', 6: 'Fa/idle_SSJC_blink', 8: 'Mo/idle_SSJC', 9: 'Mo/idle_SSJC_blink'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bianca', 3: 'There are many sea caves around this island, but this one is the most famous.', 4: '101', 18: '100019317', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'I heard that before the sea rose, you could still see traces of older human activity here.', 4: '101', 18: '100019318', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "It's only a hollow carved out by the sea, and yet it became something so beautiful.", 4: '101', 18: '100019319', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'It really is beautiful.', 3: '17'}
{2: "If you hadn't invited me, Bianca, I would've missed this incredible sight.", 3: '18'}

{1: '1', 2: 'By/idle_FXXW', 3: 'By/idle_FXXW_blink', 4: 'By/jiaocha_to_fuxiong', 5: 'Fa/idle_FXXW', 6: 'Fa/idle_FXXW_blink', 7: 'Fa/jiaocha_to_fuxiong', 8: 'Mo/idle_FXXW', 9: 'Mo/idle_FXXW_blink', 10: 'Mo/jiaocha_to_fuxiong'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'I did have a personal reason for coming here.', 4: '101', 18: '100019321', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'I once watched a film about the sea.', 4: '101', 18: '100019322', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'The protagonist grew up by the ocean. Even after losing a loved one to the sea, they could never stop loving it.', 4: '101', 18: '100019323', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Years later, the protagonist went diving with a close friend. An accident happened, and before dying, the friend asked to be buried at sea.', 4: '101', 18: '100019324', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'After that, the protagonist often dreamed of sinking to the ocean floor. He felt himself drifting farther and farther from human society.', 4: '101', 18: '100019325', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'There was always a hollow place in his heart. Maybe only the sea could fill it.', 4: '101', 18: '100019326', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'In the end, he gave up everything he once had. Only the sea could bring him peace.', 4: '101', 18: '100019327', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{2: 'Bianca', 3: "I've always wondered what made diving feel so peaceful to him. Was that peace a kind of happiness? I thought this blue hole might help me understand.", 4: '101', 18: '100019328', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'You are about to speak—'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront186.png', 4: '4', 5: '1', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_02.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_01.png', 4: '4'}
{1: '1003', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_03.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'RImgBg3Shake'}
{1: 'RImgBg4Shake'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_04.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'Clang!'}
{3: 'The boat lurches violently. A strong jolt throws you both toward one side.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_05.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_05.jpg'}
{3: 'Water splashes up, followed by the sound of something falling into the sea.'}
{3: "Your sharp eyes catch what fell. They also catch the panic and loss in Bianca's eyes the moment she realizes it's gone."}
{3: "But with the boat still rocking, she can't worry about it yet."}
{3: 'You react immediately, grabbing the oar before it can fall and using it to steady the boat.'}
{3: 'Once the oar is secure, you suddenly dive into the water, sending up another splash.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '1003', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_06.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.2'}
{1: 'RImgBg3Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_07.jpg'}
{3: "It all happens too fast. Bianca realizes the boat may have struck a submerged rock or reef, but she doesn't understand why you jumped in."}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_07.jpg', 6: '2', 7: '0|-540|-80'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_08.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1003', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_09.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.2'}
{3: 'Whatever the reason is, Bianca is already at the side of the boat.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_10.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'A hand in the water stops her before she can dive in. You resurface almost immediately.'}
{1: '1003', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_09.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_01_11.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{2: 'Part of the hull is caught on an underwater reef.', 3: '95'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Commandant...! Please get back in the boat!', 18: '100019331'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "Why did you jump in without warning me? What if you'd been hurt? If you needed something, I could have—", 18: '100019332'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_01.jpg', 7: '0|0|0'}
{3: 'Your voice pulls Bianca out of her daze. She lets out a quiet breath, though her brow remains furrowed.'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "...I'm sorry. I shouldn't have lost my composure.", 18: '100019333'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "But I still mean what I said. You shouldn't have jumped in like that.", 18: '100019334'}
{2: "I'm sorry for worrying you.", 3: '104'}
{2: 'But trust me. I knew what I was doing.', 3: '105'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_02.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_02.jpg'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'I do trust you, Commandant. Please come back aboard. So the reason you jumped...', 18: '100019335'}
{3: "Bianca leans over the boat's edge and reaches out to help. That's when she sees what you are holding."}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_03.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_03.jpg'}
{1: '2', 4: '0', 5: '0.05', 7: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_03.jpg', 8: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_04.jpg'}
{3: 'The blue light of the cave shimmers in her eyes. Now she understands why you dove in.'}
{3: 'You answer her outstretched hand in another way.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '2', 2: '1', 7: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_03.jpg', 8: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_04.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_05.jpg'}
{3: 'The starfish shell that fell into the sea is now tied around her wrist with the pale-gold byssus cord that had been around your neck.'}
{2: "Sea caves are formed by erosion. That's true.", 3: '123'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "But a hollow doesn't have to be filled only by seawater."}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'Just like this abandoned boat became home to a small new ecosystem by the shore.'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'This blue hole has its own ecosystem too.'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "And it's because there are cracks for light to enter that this cave looks the way it does now."}
{2: "Bianca, the blue hole isn't lonely.", 3: '128'}
{2: 'And I believe the protagonist can find happiness too.', 3: '129'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_06.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_06.jpg'}
{3: "Bianca's wrist is slender. You wrap the byssus cord around it a few times, making sure the starfish is secure."}
{2: "There. It shouldn't fall off now.", 3: '134'}
{2: "I hope you don't mind that I was wearing it before.", 3: '135'}
{1: '2', 4: '0.5', 5: '0.8', 7: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_07.jpg', 8: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_08.jpg'}
{3: 'Bianca stares at the simple new bracelet on her wrist, lost in thought.'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Why would I mind? This... makes it even better.', 18: '100019336'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Please come back up.', 18: '100019337'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '2', 2: '1', 4: '0.5', 5: '0.8', 7: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_07.jpg', 8: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_02_08.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_03_01.jpg'}
{3: 'With a gentle shake of your head, you swim to the bow instead, where the boat is wedged between two underwater rocks.'}
{2: 'Give me a moment.', 3: '145'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_03_02.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_03_02.jpg'}
{3: 'You push against the boat, trying to free it from the rocks.'}
{3: 'But the boat is stuck tight. To free it without damaging the rocks or the hull, you will need to push from two directions at once.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_03_03.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_03_03.jpg'}
{3: 'A soft splash sounds nearby.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V470Bianca_summer/V470_03_04.jpg'}
{3: "Bianca's ivory hair and sheer fabric drift through the water, like a sea nymph from an old legend."}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "Commandant, let's do it together.", 18: '100019338'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1575.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront186.png', 4: '4', 7: '0|-80|0'}
{1: '1', 2: 'By/idle_CS', 3: 'By/idle_CS_blink', 5: 'Fa/idle_CS', 6: 'Fa/idle_CS_blink', 8: 'Mo/idle_CS', 9: 'Mo/idle_CS_blink'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Working together, you finally free the boat.'}
{3: "After helping each other back into the boat, you look at each other, both soaked and a little disheveled, and can't help laughing."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory785.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '0.8', 5: '0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory783.jpg'}
{3: 'Your time in the blue hole is nearly over.'}
{3: 'You return the way you came. By the time you see the open sky again, the pink sunset has deepened into purple dusk.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'By/idle_CS', 3: 'By/idle_CS_blink', 5: 'Fa/idle_CS', 6: 'Fa/idle_CS_blink', 8: 'Mo/idle_CS', 9: 'Mo/idle_CS_blink'}
{2: 'I still ended up making you jump in too.', 3: '181'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'How could I let you handle that alone?', 4: '101', 18: '100019339', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Without proper training, staying in the water too long can lead to hypothermia.', 4: '101', 18: '100019340', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "I trust your physical condition, Commandant, but I don't want you taking that kind of risk.", 4: '101', 18: '100019341', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{1: '1', 2: 'By/idle_FXXW', 3: 'By/idle_FXXW_blink', 4: 'By/chuishou_to_fuxiong', 5: 'Fa/idle_FXXW', 6: 'Fa/idle_FXXW_blink', 7: 'Fa/chuishou_to_fuxiong', 8: 'Mo/idle_FXXW', 9: 'Mo/idle_FXXW_blink', 10: 'Mo/chuishou_to_fuxiong'}
{2: 'Yeah, I notice that too...', 3: '192'}
{2: "The boat's heading is off.", 3: '193'}
{3: 'She nods.'}
{3: "As you speak, the boat is heading toward the main island, but it's not staying on course."}
{3: 'It has also started to slow down.'}
{3: 'You watch for a moment.'}
{2: 'The stern oar is cracked.', 3: '199'}
{2: "That's why the boat keeps drifting whenever we row.", 3: '200'}
{1: '1', 2: 'By/idle_FXXW', 3: 'By/idle_FXXW_blink', 5: 'Fa/idle_FXXW', 6: 'Fa/idle_FXXW_blink', 8: 'Mo/idle_FXXW', 9: 'Mo/idle_FXXW_blink'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'It must have happened when we hit the reef earlier.', 4: '101', 18: '100019343', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'At this rate, the trip back will take longer than the trip out.', 4: '101', 18: '100019344', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'That part is fine.', 3: '205'}
{3: 'The sky is getting darker, and the cool wind of the summer night begins to rise.'}
{3: 'For both of you, already soaked through, the wind feels even colder.'}
{2: 'It might get cold if we stay out much longer.', 3: '211', 4: "I'm worried you'll get cold, Bianca.", 5: '231'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "Are you cold, Commandant? I'll find a way to fix that.", 4: '101', 18: '100019345', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "The accident happened because I wasn't careful enough.", 4: '101', 18: '100019347', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'I was told: The warmth of two people together can overcome even the coldest of winters in this world.', 3: '214'}
{3: 'Bianca pauses. Then the guilt on her face softens into a fond, wistful smile.'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Yes... I once made it through a snowstorm because of the warmth we shared.', 4: '101', 18: '100019348', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'If that warmth can get us through a winter storm, it can get us through cold seawater and night wind too.', 4: '101', 18: '100019349', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{1: '1', 2: 'By/idle_SSJC', 3: 'By/idle_SSJC_blink', 4: 'By/fuxiong_to_jiaocha', 5: 'Fa/idle_SSJC', 6: 'Fa/idle_SSJC_blink', 7: 'Fa/fuxiong_to_jiaocha', 8: 'Mo/idle_SSJC', 9: 'Mo/idle_SSJC_blink', 10: 'Mo/fuxiong_to_jiaocha'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Commandant... I have a suggestion.', 4: '101', 18: '100019350', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "I don't want you catching a chill.", 4: '101', 18: '100019351', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{3: "You shift closer and gently lean against Bianca's shoulder. Bianca lowers her cheek to your head, careful as though touching something fragile."}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'You should worry about yourself before worrying about me.', 4: '101', 18: '100019346', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "The accident happened because I wasn't careful enough.", 4: '101', 18: '100019347', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'I was told: The warmth of two people together can overcome even the coldest of winters in this world.', 3: '234'}
{3: 'Bianca pauses. Then the guilt on her face softens into a fond, wistful smile.'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Yes... I once made it through a snowstorm because of the warmth we shared.', 4: '101', 18: '100019348', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'If that warmth can get us through a winter storm, it can get us through cold seawater and night wind too.', 4: '101', 18: '100019349', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}

{1: '1', 2: 'By/idle_SSJC', 3: 'By/idle_SSJC_blink', 4: 'By/fuxiong_to_jiaocha', 5: 'Fa/idle_SSJC', 6: 'Fa/idle_SSJC_blink', 7: 'Fa/fuxiong_to_jiaocha', 8: 'Mo/idle_SSJC', 9: 'Mo/idle_SSJC_blink', 10: 'Mo/fuxiong_to_jiaocha'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Commandant... I have a suggestion.', 4: '101', 18: '100019350', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "If you're worried about me, then I'm allowed to worry about you. So...", 4: '101', 18: '100019353', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{3: 'You lean in without a word. Bianca slowly, carefully rests against your shoulder, her breathing almost softer than before.'}
{3: 'The warmth they share makes up for the heat the evening wind keeps stealing away.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'After a while, Bianca lifts her head.'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'I wish this moment could last a little longer... but Commandant, the sun is almost down.', 4: '101', 18: '100019355', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'That singing in the distance... Is the evening festival about to begin?', 4: '101', 18: '100019356', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Seems like it.', 3: '262'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: "I'm sorry. I invited you out here and ended up wasting so much of your time.", 4: '101', 18: '100019357', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'No one would call a journey like this a waste of time.', 3: '265'}
{2: "Besides, we're not too far from the main island now.", 3: '266'}
{2: "We may miss the opening, but we'll make it to the festival.", 3: '267'}
{3: 'A splash sounds nearby.'}
{3: 'Neither of you is rowing, so the sound must have come from something in the water.'}
{3: 'A triangular dorsal fin breaks the surface. You both tense, only for a familiar head to pop up after it.'}
{3: 'This time, you understand the dolphin right away and row after it.'}
{3: 'Soon, you see why the dolphin brought you here.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'By/idle_SSJC', 3: 'By/idle_SSJC_blink', 5: 'Fa/idle_SSJC', 6: 'Fa/idle_SSJC_blink', 8: 'Mo/idle_SSJC', 9: 'Mo/idle_SSJC_blink'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bianca', 3: 'The water here seems to be pushing us toward shore.', 4: '101', 18: '100019359', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: "It's an onshore current.", 3: '283'}
{2: 'An onshore current is a nearshore current that runs perpendicular to the coastline and flows toward shore.', 3: '284'}
{3: 'Bianca looks at the dolphin.'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'You risked getting stranded just to lead us into a current that could carry us back?', 4: '101', 18: '100019360', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'Thank you... You really are a miracle.', 4: '101', 18: '100019361', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'Riding the onshore current, you move toward the coast much faster.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront186.png', 4: '4', 5: '1', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1195.jpg'}
{3: 'Before the singing ends, you finally make it back to land.'}
{3: 'Villagers pass by in festival clothes, probably on their way to the celebration.'}
{3: 'Two older villagers walking together stop in surprise when they see you and Bianca, both soaked.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Villager', 3: 'Oh my, why are you two soaked through?', 4: '102', 18: '100019362', 19: '2', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Villager', 3: 'Did you fall into the sea? Quick, go get them a couple of towels. Big ones.', 4: '102', 18: '100019363', 19: '2', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Thank you. We went to the blue hole.', 3: '303'}
{2: 'Villager', 3: "You found the entrance without a local guide? Now that's something.", 4: '102', 18: '100019365', 19: '2', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'We met a... friend who was kind enough to show us the way.', 4: '101', 18: '100019367', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Yes. We met a very kind friend out at sea.', 3: '310'}
{2: 'Villager', 3: "All the locals are busy moving and getting ready for the festival. Who else could've shown you the way?", 4: '102', 18: '100019368', 19: '2', 21: 'v470summer'}
{2: 'Villager', 3: 'Well, maybe the Sea Spirit showed herself.', 4: '102', 18: '100019369', 19: '2', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'A brief splash comes from the shore, and the shadow of a dorsal fin slips into the dark sea.'}
{3: "You and Bianca exchange a glance, each reading the same thought in the other's eyes."}
{2: 'Bianca', 3: 'I did witness many miracles today.', 4: '101', 18: '100019371', 19: '1', 21: 'v470summer'}
{3: 'A knowing smile crosses her lips. As the evening wind lifts her hair, Bianca gathers it back. On her raised wrist, the pale-gold bracelet glimmers softly.'}
